name: Hegemony Directorate
description: The authoritarian heir to the old core governments. Orderly, heavily armed and deeply suspicious of everyone else.

name: Tri-Corp
description: A megacorporation that owns its worlds outright. Rich, technologically superior and pragmatic about almost everything.

name: Free Trade League
description: A loose federation of frontier merchant worlds. Low tariffs, few questions, and a navy that mostly escorts convoys.

name: Ascendant Path
description: Zealots who believe humanity must purify itself before it reaches the galactic core. They ban luxuries and burn AI cores.

name: Independent Worlds
description: Unaligned colonies and free stations. They trade with anyone and fight only to defend themselves.

name: Pirate Clans
description: Raiders, smugglers and worse, operating from hidden havens in the fringe. Their markets sell anything to anyone with credits.
